sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000133-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Riverbend Physician Alliance 133 on August 15, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 630 Hepatitis doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
